name: Calling Someone An Idiot
overview: Scripture warns against calling others fools or idiots, emphasizing the importance of wisdom and restraint in speech. The fool is characterized by a heart that denies God and engages in corrupt actions, while a lack of wisdom leads to despising neighbors rather than showing understanding. Wise speech brings healing and peace, whereas harsh words provoke anger. Even a fool may be considered wise by holding their tongue, highlighting the value of self-control in communication.
